2608.21357.title: VIALS: A Benchmark for Visual Interpretation of Artifacts in the Life Sciences
2608.21357.paper_summary: In professional life sciences workflows, scientists routinely interpret visual artifacts (gel blots, microscopy images, plasmid maps, flow cytometry plots, molecular structures, ...) to inform research decisions. We introduce VIALS, a visual question-answering benchmark with 161 such interpretation tasks, spanning the types of artifacts examined throughout experimental workflows in the biotech industry (rather than polished figures from publications and textbooks). While frontier vision-language models can now fluently describe natural images, we find that they are unable to accurately interpret these scientific images, reflecting limitations in domain knowledge and domain-specific visual reasoning capabilities. In contrast, scientists with relevant domain expertise find these visual interpretation tasks straightforward. AI that cannot similarly interpret such images will have limited utility in professional life sciences workflows, where such artifacts are central to how scientists reason, communicate, and make decisions.
2608.21357.paper_summary_zh: 在專業生命科學工作流程中，科學家們經常解釋視覺工件（凝膠印跡、顯微鏡影像、質粒圖、流式細胞術圖、分子結構等）以指導研究決策。我們介紹 VIALS，這是一個視覺問答基準，包含 161 個此類解釋任務，涵蓋生技產業實驗工作流程中所檢查的工件類型（而非來自出版物和教科書的精緻圖形）。雖然前沿的視覺-語言模型現在可以流利地描述自然影像，但我們發現它們無法準確解釋這些科學影像，這反映出在領域知識和領域特定視覺推理能力上的限制。相比之下，擁有相關領域專業知識的科學家發現這些視覺解釋任務相對簡單。無法以類似方式解釋這些影像的人工智慧在專業生命科學工作流程中的效用將受到限制，因為這些工件對於科學家推理、溝通和做出決策的方式至關重要。
